author: Hebyby
attribution: Photo: Hebyby, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Orientational_sign_post_orbital_roads_of_Babrujsk,_Belarus.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large blue Belarusian-language advance direction sign for the Babrujsk ring road, with ў, ё and і. Road-number letters are homoglyphs: national routes written with Cyrillic Р/М, European route E271 with Latin E. A smaller lane sign at lower left (Р43 БАБРУЙСК, МІНСК, ГОМЕЛЬ, ГЛУСК, МАЗЫР, 300м) is a secondary sign.
source_title: File:Orientational sign post orbital roads of Babrujsk, Belarus.JPG
